qe: Under Article 324, the superintendence, direction and control of elections to Parliament, State Legislatures and the offices of President and Vice-President is vested in:
qh: अनुच्छेद 324 के अंतर्गत संसद, राज्य विधानमंडल तथा राष्ट्रपति एवं उपराष्ट्रपति के पदों के निर्वाचन का अधीक्षण, निर्देशन और नियंत्रण किसमें निहित है?
oe: The Election Commission of India
The Ministry of Law and Justice
The Union Cabinet
NITI Aayog
oh: भारत निर्वाचन आयोग
विधि और न्याय मंत्रालय
केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल
नीति आयोग
e: Article 324 ke tehat bharat nirvachan aayog (Election Commission of India) ke paas sansad, rajya vidhanmandalon, rashtrapati aur up-rashtrapati ke nirvachan ka sampoorn adhikar hai - adhykshan (superintendence), nirdeshan aur niyantran. ECI me Chief Election Commissioner tatha do Election Commissioner hote hain; yeh teen-sadasyiye swaroop 1993 se hai. July 2023 ke baad niyukti CEC and Other ECs (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023 ke tehat ek chayan samiti karti hai, jisme pradhanmantri, lok sabha ke neta prati paksh aur pradhanmantri dwara nominate kiya gaya ek kendra mantri shaamil hote hain. Karyakal chhah saal ya 65 saal ki umar tak hota hai. Law Ministry chunav karane wali sanstha nahi hai, Cabinet chunav ka faisla nahi karta, aur NITI Aayog ek policy think tank hai jiska chunav se koi lena-dena nahi. Exam point: Article 324 = ECI ko sansad, vidhanmandal, rashtrapati aur up-rashtrapati ke chunav ka adhikar; CEC ki niyukti 2023 wale kanoon ki chayan samiti se.

qe: Elections to the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies are held on the basis of adult suffrage under Article 326; the voting age was reduced from 21 to 18 years by which amendment?
qh: अनुच्छेद 326 के अंतर्गत लोकसभा तथा राज्य विधानसभाओं के चुनाव वयस्क मताधिकार के आधार पर होते हैं; मतदान की आयु 21 से 18 वर्ष किस संशोधन द्वारा की गई?
oe: 42nd Amendment, 1976
44th Amendment, 1978
61st Amendment, 1988
73rd Amendment, 1992
e: Article 326 kehta hai ki lok sabha aur rajya vidhan sabhaon ke chunav vayask matadhikar (adult suffrage) ke aadhaar par honge, yaani har woh vyakti jo nirdharit umar se upar hai aur jiske naam nirvachak suchi me hain, vote de sakta hai. Pehle yeh umar 21 saal thi; 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 ne ise 21 se ghata kar 18 saal kiya, aur yeh pravdhan 1989 ke aam chunav se lagu hua. 42nd Amendment 1976 ne bahut se badlav kiye jaise kuch sandhi ke kuch sanshodhit karna, lekin matadhikar ki umar nahi badli; 44th Amendment 1978 ne sampatti ke adhikar ko fundamental right se hata kar Article 300A banaya, isliye woh bhi is prashn se mel nahi khaata. 73rd Amendment 1992 panchayati raj se juda hai, matadhikar ki umar se nahi. Exam point: vote ki umar 18 saal = 61st Amendment, 1988; pehla aam chunav jisme yeh lagu hua = 1989.

qe: Elections to Panchayats and Municipalities are conducted by which authority, and under which constitutional articles?
qh: पंचायतों तथा नगरपालिकाओं के चुनाव किस प्राधिकरण द्वारा और किन संवैधानिक अनुच्छेदों के अंतर्गत कराए जाते हैं?
oe: By the local bodies themselves, under Article 243A
By the State Election Commission, under Articles 243K and 243ZA
By the Election Commission of India, under Article 324
By the District Collector, under Article 243B
oh: स्थानीय निकाय स्वयं, अनुच्छेद 243A के अंतर्गत
राज्य निर्वाचन आयोग द्वारा, अनुच्छेद 243K तथा 243ZA के अंतर्गत
भारत निर्वाचन आयोग द्वारा, अनुच्छेद 324 के अंतर्गत
जिला कलेक्टर द्वारा, अनुच्छेद 243B के अंतर्गत
e: 73rd Amendment (panchayat) aur 74th Amendment (nagar palika) ne sthaneya nikayon ke chunav ka bhar rajya nirvachan aayog (State Election Commission) ko diya hai. Iska sanvaidhanik adhaar Article 243K hai, jo panchayaton ke chunav ke adhykshan, nirdeshan aur niyantran ki shakti State Election Commission ko deta hai, aur Article 243ZA, jo nagariya nikayon (municipalities) ke liye wahi vyavastha karta hai. ECI sirf sansad, vidhanmandal, rashtrapati aur up-rashtrapati ke chunav dekhta hai, isliye Article 324 wala vikalp galat hai. Article 243A panchayat ke adhyaksh (jaise sarpanch, mukhiya) ke chunav ke baare me hai, nikay ke chunav ke nyay ke baare me nahi, aur Article 243B panchayaton ke gathan ke baare me hai; isliye yeh dono vikalp galat hain. District Collector nirvachan adhikari ke roop me kaam kar sakta hai, lekin sanvaidhanik roop se chunav karane wala adhikari nahi hai. Exam point: 243K = panchayat chunav, 243ZA = nagariya nikay chunav, dono ka prashasan Rajya Nirvachan Aayog ke paas.

qe: Registration of political parties is done by the Election Commission of India under which provision?
qh: राजनीतिक दलों का पंजीकरण भारत निर्वाचन आयोग किस प्रावधान के अंतर्गत करता है?
oe: Section 29A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951
Article 324 of the Constitution directly
The Political Parties Registration Act, 1985
Section 123 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951
oh: लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम, 1951 की धारा 29A
सीधे संविधान के अनुच्छेद 324 के अंतर्गत
राजनीतिक दल पंजीकरण अधिनियम, 1985
लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम, 1951 की धारा 123
e: Rajniti dal ka panjikaran ka aadhaar Section 29A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 hai; isi ke tehat nirvachan aayog dalon ka panjikaran karta hai tatha panjikrit dalon ki suchi banata hai. Panjikaran ke baad dal ko 'manyata' (recognition) milne ka prashn alag hai - national party ya state party ka darja aur chunav chinh (symbol) ka aavedan Election Symbols (Reservation and Allotment) Order, 1968 ke tehat tay hote hain. Article 324 ECI ki shakti ka samanya source hai, lekin dal-registration ka vishesh kanoon nahi hai, isliye woh vikalp galat hai. 'Political Parties Registration Act, 1985' naam ka koi adhiniyam nahi hai. Section 123 RPA 1951 corrupt practices (jaise rishvat, dhamki) ke baare me hai, panjikaran se nahi. Exam point: dal ka panjikaran = Sec 29A RPA 1951; manyata tatha chunav chinh = Election Symbols Order, 1968.

qe: Which of the following is a valid criterion for recognition as a 'National Party' by the Election Commission of India?
qh: भारत निर्वाचन आयोग द्वारा 'राष्ट्रीय दल' के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त करने का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा मानदंड वैध है?
oe: Securing 6% of the votes polled in four states and winning at least 2 Lok Sabha seats
Securing at least 2% of the total Lok Sabha seats (11 seats) with members elected from at least three different states, or being a recognised state party in at least four states
Winning a by-election in five different states within one year
Getting 10% of the valid votes in a single state
oh: चार राज्यों में पड़े वोटों का 6% तथा कम से कम 2 लोकसभा सीटें जीतना
कुल लोकसभा सीटों का कम से कम 2% (11 सीटें) प्राप्त करना, जिनके सदस्य कम से कम तीन राज्यों से निर्वाचित हों, अथवा कम से कम चार राज्यों में मान्यता प्राप्त राज्य दल होना
एक वर्ष के भीतर पाँच भिन्न राज्यों में उपचुनाव जीतना
किसी एक राज्य में वैध वोटों का 10% प्राप्त करना
e: Nirvachan aayog ki 2016 me sanshodhit sharotein ke mutabik dal ko rashtriya dal ke roop me manyata milne ke teen raaste hain. Pehla: lok sabha ya vidhan sabha ke aam chunav me char rajyon me kam se kam 6% vaidh vote tatha lok sabha ki kam se kam 4 seats jeetna. Doosra: lok sabha ke kul chunavon me kam se kam 2% (aaj 543 me 11) seats jeetna, lekin ve sadasya kam se kam teen alag-alag rajyon se nirvachit hone chahiye. Teesra: kam se kam char rajyon me manyata prapt rajya dal ke roop me pehchana jaana. Isliye '6% vote aur keval 2 lok sabha seats' wala vikalp adhura hai, kyunki us aadhaar par 4 seats chahiye; up-chunav (by-election) jitna ya kisi ek rajya me 10% vote lena rashtriya dal ki manyata ka aadhaar kabhi nahi tha. Dal ki manyata ka nirnayan chunav ke baad vote share aur seat ka aankda milne par hota hai, isliye yah ek ganit-astarit niyam hai. Exam point: rashtriya dal = 4 rajyon me 6% plus 4 LS seats, ya 2% LS seats teen rajyon se, ya 4 rajyon me manyata prapt rajya dal.

qe: The Tenth Schedule (anti-defection law) was added to the Constitution by which amendment, and who decides questions of disqualification under it?
qh: दसवीं अनुसूची (दल-बदल विरोधी कानून) किस संशोधन द्वारा संविधान में जोड़ी गई, और इसके अंतर्गत निरर्हता के प्रश्न का निर्णय कौन करता है?
oe: 42nd Amendment, 1976; the President decides
52nd Amendment, 1985; the Speaker or Chairman of the House decides
61st Amendment, 1988; the Election Commission decides
91st Amendment, 2003; the Supreme Court decides
oh: 42वाँ संशोधन, 1976; राष्ट्रपति निर्णय करता है
52वाँ संशोधन, 1985; सदन का अध्यक्ष या सभापति निर्णय करता है
61वाँ संशोधन, 1988; निर्वाचन आयोग निर्णय करता है
91वाँ संशोधन, 2003; सर्वोच्च न्यायालय निर्णय करता है
e: Dal-badal (defection) ko rokne ke liye 52nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1985 ke tehat Tenth Schedule sanvidhan me joda gaya. Iske tehat kisi sadasya ko nirh (disqualify) karne ke do mukhya aadhaar hain: pehla, woh swachchha se dal ki sadasystha chhod de ya uske sadasyatva se haath dho le; doosra, woh dal ke nirdesh (whip) ke virudh vote de ya sadan ki karyavahi se gayr-hazir rahe. In aadhaaron par nirnay sadan ka adhyaksh (Lok Sabha/Vidhan Sabha me Speaker) ya sabhapati (Rajya Sabha/Vidhan Parishad me Chairman) karta hai, isliye Election Commission ya Supreme Court ke naam wale vikalp galat hain. 91st Amendment, 2003 ne Tenth Schedule se 'ek-tihai (one-third) sadasya alag ho jaane' wala bachav hata diya, yaani ab split ke naam par koi surakhsha nahi hai aur vilay (merger) ke liye dal ke do-tihai sadasyaon ka samarthan chahiye; isi 91st Amendment ne mantri parishad ke sadasyon ki sankhya sadan ke kul sadasyaon ke 15% kar di. Exam point: 52nd Amendment 1985 = Tenth Schedule; faisla Speaker/Chairman; 91st Amendment 2003 = one-third split wala bachav khatam, merger ke liye two-thirds.

qe: Under Article 329(b) of the Constitution, elections to Parliament and State Legislatures can be called in question:
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 329(b) के अंतर्गत संसद तथा राज्य विधानमंडलों के निर्वाचन को प्रश्नगत किया जा सकता है -
oe: only by an election petition presented as provided by a law made by the appropriate legislature
by any writ petition filed in the Supreme Court within 30 days
by a resolution of the House concerned
by a referendum initiated by the Election Commission
oh: केवल उचित विधानमंडल द्वारा बनाए गए कानून के अनुसार प्रस्तुत निर्वाचन याचिका (election petition) द्वारा
30 दिन के भीतर सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में दायर किसी भी रिट याचिका द्वारा
संबंधित सदन के प्रस्ताव द्वारा
निर्वाचन आयोग द्वारा शुरू किए गए जनमत संग्रह द्वारा
e: Article 329(b) ka pravdhan hai ki sansad ya rajya vidhanmandal ke kisi bhi nirvachan ko chunauti dene ka ek hi raasta hai - kanoon dwara nirdharit prakriya ke tehat election petition dena; isi karan kisi sadharan writ yachika se chunav ko mukabla nahi kiya ja sakta. Representation of the People Act, 1951 ke tehat aisi yachika sambandhit High Court me di jaati hai aur uske faisle ke khilaf Supreme Court me appeal ho sakti hai. '30 din ke andar koi bhi writ' wala vikalp galat hai kyunki sanvidhan ne vishesh prakriya tay ki hai, sadharan writ ka raasta band hai. Sadan ke prastav ya nirvachan aayog dwara janmat sangrah jaise upayon ka sanvidhan me koi zikr nahi hai, isliye woh vikalp nir-aadhar hain. Exam point: Article 329(b) = nirvachan ko keval election petition se chunauti; petition RPA 1951 ke tehat High Court me.

qe: The NOTA (None of the Above) option on EVMs was introduced following a Supreme Court judgment in which case?
qh: ईवीएम पर नोटा (इनमें से कोई नहीं) विकल्प किस मामले में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के निर्णय के बाद शुरू किया गया?
oe: S.R. Bommai v. Union of India, 1994
People's Union for Civil Liberties v. Union of India, 2013
Association for Democratic Reforms v. Union of India, 2002
Indira Nehru Gandhi v. Raj Narain, 1975
oh: एस.आर. बोम्मई बनाम भारत संघ, 1994
पीपुल्स यूनियन फॉर सिविल लिबर्टीज बनाम भारत संघ, 2013
एसोसिएशन फॉर डेमोक्रेटिक रिफॉर्म्स बनाम भारत संघ, 2002
इंदिरा नेहरू गांधी बनाम राज नारायण, 1975
e: September 2013 me Supreme Court ne PUCL (People's Union for Civil Liberties) v. Union of India wale maamle me apna faisla dete hue kaha ki nirvachakon ko 'inme se koi nahi' (NOTA) chunne ka adhikar milna chahiye, jisse unhe kisi bhi ummidwar ko chunne ke liye vivash na hona pade; isi aadesh par EVM me NOTA ka option joda gaya. Iska pehla istemal November-December 2013 ke vidhan sabha chunavon me hua. Dhyaan rahe - NOTA ka vote gine jaate hain aur uski sankhya dikhai jaati hai, lekin nirvachan ka nateeja nahi badalta; sabse zyada vote pane wala ummidwar hi chuna jaata hai, chaahe NOTA ko usse zyada vote mile hon. S.R. Bommai 1994 ka maamla Article 356 aur rajy sarkar ke gathan se juda tha, ADR 2002 ka faisla ummidwaron ki aaparadhik tatha aarthik jaankari jahir karne ke bare me tha, aur Indira Nehru Gandhi v. Raj Narain 1975 ka maamla chunav ko vaidh thahrane se juda tha. Exam point: NOTA = PUCL faisla, September 2013; pehla istemal 2013 ke vidhan sabha chunavon me; NOTA se parinaam nahi badalta.

qe: Under Article 5 of the Constitution, a person became a citizen of India at the commencement of the Constitution (26 January 1950) if he had his domicile in India and fulfilled which of the following conditions?
qh: संविधान के लागू होने (26 जनवरी 1950) के समय अनुच्छेद 5 के अनुसार कोई व्यक्ति भारत का नागरिक तब बना जब उसका भारत में अधिवास (domicile) था और उसने निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी शर्त पूरी की?
oe: He was born in India only; no other route was available at commencement
He was born in India, or either of his parents was born in India, or he had been ordinarily resident in India for not less than five years immediately preceding the commencement
He was merely residing somewhere in India on 15 August 1947, even without domicile
He had obtained a registration certificate from a diplomatic mission of India
oh: वह केवल भारत में जन्मा हो; लागू होने के समय कोई अन्य मार्ग उपलब्ध नहीं था
वह भारत में जन्मा हो, अथवा उसके माता-पिता में से किसी एक का जन्म भारत में हुआ हो, अथवा वह लागू होने से ठीक पहले कम से कम पाँच वर्ष तक भारत में साधारण निवासी रहा हो
वह 15 अगस्त 1947 को भारत में कहीं निवास कर रहा हो, चाहे उसका अधिवास न हो
उसने भारत के किसी राजनयिक मिशन से पंजीकरण प्रमाणपत्र प्राप्त कर लिया हो
e: Sanvidhan ke lagu hone ke samay 26 January 1950 ki nagrikta ka pehla niyam Article 5 hai, jo do cheezein ek saath maangta hai: pehla, vyakti ka India me 'domicile' (adhiwas) hona chahiye; doosra, uske paas teen aadhaaron me se kam se kam ek hona chahiye - India me janm, maa-baap me se kisi ek ka India me janm, ya lagu hone se theek pehle kam se kam paanch saal India me sadharan nivasi (ordinarily resident) hona. Domicile ka matlab hai woh desh jahan vyakti sthayi roop se rahna chahta hai; isliye keval 15 August 1947 ko kahin nivas karna ya keval janm ke aadhaar par dawa karna adhura hai, kyunki Article 5 janm, maa-baap ke janm aur paanch saal ke nivasi-kal - teenon me se koi ek raasta deta hai, kisi ek ko anivarya nahi karta. Sanvidhan lagu hone ke samay diplomatic registration ka raasta maujood nahi tha; woh raasta Article 8 ke tehat baad me bahar rahne wale Indian origin logon ke liye aaya. Exam point: Article 5 = domicile plus teen me se ek shart (janm / maa-baap ka janm / paanch saal ka nivasi-kal).

qe: Which Article of the Constitution specifically deals with the citizenship rights of persons who migrated to India from Pakistan after Partition?
qh: विभाजन के बाद पाकिस्तान से भारत आकर बसे व्यक्तियों की नागरिकता से संबंधित विशिष्ट प्रावधान संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद में है?
oe: Article 5
Article 6
Article 8
Article 11
oh: अनुच्छेद 5
अनुच्छेद 6
अनुच्छेद 8
अनुच्छेद 11
e: Vibhajan ke baad do tarah ke logon ka sawal khada hua: jo Pakistan se bharat aa kar bas gaye, aur jo bharat se Pakistan chale gaye. Article 6 un logon ke liye hai jo Pakistan se bharat aa kar bas gaye; jo 19 July 1948 se pehle aaye the unhe usi samay se nagrik maana gaya, aur us tareekh ke baad permit par aane wale logon ko kuch shartein poori karni padi. Article 5 to 26 January 1950 ki samanya nagrikta ka niyam hai aur isme Pakistan se aane wale migrants ka alag zikr nahi hai. Article 8 un Indian origin logon ke liye hai jo bahar rehte hain aur indian mission me registration karate hain, isliye woh bhi is prashn se mel nahi khaata. Article 11 Parliament ko nagrikta sambandhi kanoon banane ki shakti deta hai; kisi varg ko seedha nagrik nahi banata. Exam point: 6 = Pakistan se bharat aane wale, 7 = Pakistan jaane wale, 8 = videsh me rahne wale Indian origin vyakti, 9 = videshi nagrikta lene par nagrikta ka ant.

qe: If an Indian citizen voluntarily acquires the citizenship of a foreign country, what is the effect on his Indian citizenship under Article 9 of the Constitution?
qh: यदि कोई भारतीय नागरिक स्वेच्छा से किसी विदेशी देश की नागरिकता ग्रहण कर ले, तो संविधान के अनुच्छेद 9 के अनुसार उसकी भारतीय नागरिकता पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
oe: He remains an Indian citizen also, because India permits dual citizenship
His Indian citizenship automatically ceases
His Indian citizenship stays valid until he surrenders his Indian passport
His Indian citizenship is suspended for five years and then restored
oh: वह भारतीय नागरिक भी बना रहता है, क्योंकि भारत दोहरी नागरिकता की अनुमति देता है
उसकी भारतीय नागरिकता स्वतः समाप्त हो जाती है
उसकी भारतीय नागरिकता तब तक वैध रहती है जब तक वह अपना भारतीय पासपोर्ट जमा न कर दे
उसकी भारतीय नागरिकता पाँच वर्ष के लिए निलंबित रहती है और फिर बहाल हो जाती है
e: Article 9 saaf kehta hai ki jo vyakti swachchha se kisi videshi desh ki nagrikta le leta hai, wo apne aap bharat ki nagrikta kho deta hai; iske liye kisi sarkari order ya notice ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Isliye 'foreign citizenship ke saath Indian citizenship bani rahegi' wala vikalp galat hai, kyunki bharat dual citizenship (dohri nagrikta) ko manzoor nahi karta. Passport jama karne ka niyam ek procedure hai; nagrikta ka ant passport surrender par nahi, videshi nagrikta grahan karne ke kshan hi ho jaata hai, isliye surrender tak nagrikta bani rehne wala vikalp theek nahi. Nagrikta ko paanch saal ke liye nilambit karne jaisi koi vyavastha bharat ke kanoon me nahi hai. Dhyaan rahe - OCI card nagrikta nahi hai, balki bharat me lambi avadhi tak rahne ki suvidha dene wala darja hai; OCI holder vote nahi de sakta aur rashtrapati, up-rashtrapati, judge ya sansad ka sadasya nahi ban sakta. Exam point: Article 9 = videshi nagrikta lene par bharatiya nagrikta ka ant; bharat me dual citizenship nahi hai.

qe: Under which Article, and before which authority, does a person of Indian origin residing abroad get himself registered to acquire Indian citizenship?
qh: विदेश में रहने वाला भारतीय मूल का व्यक्ति भारतीय नागरिकता पाने के लिए किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत और किस प्राधिकरण के समक्ष पंजीकरण कराता है?
oe: Under Article 5, with the Election Commission of India
Under Article 8, with a diplomatic or consular representative of India in that country
Under Article 7, with the Ministry of Home Affairs
Under Article 11, with the Supreme Court of India
oh: अनुच्छेद 5 के अंतर्गत, भारत निर्वाचन आयोग के समक्ष
अनुच्छेद 8 के अंतर्गत, उस देश में भारत के राजनयिक या कांसुलर प्रतिनिधि के समक्ष
अनुच्छेद 7 के अंतर्गत, गृह मंत्रालय के समक्ष
अनुच्छेद 11 के अंतर्गत, भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के समक्ष
e: Article 8 un vyaktiyon ke liye vishesh raasta kholta hai jo bharat se bahar rehte hain lekin Indian origin ke hain: unhe apne desh me bharat ke diplomatic ya consular representative ke paas apna naam register karana hota hai, aur is registration ke baad unhain wahi darja milta hai jo bharat me rahne wale Indian origin vyakti ko milta hai. Election Commission ke samne registration ka koi aadhaar nahi hai, kyunki woh voter suchi aur chunav se juda aayog hai, nagrikta ka record nahi rakhta. Article 7 Pakistan jaane wale logon ki baat karta hai, isliye Home Ministry wala vikalp is prashn se mel nahi khaata. Article 11 Parliament ki vidhayi shakti ke baare me hai aur Supreme Court kisi ki nagrikta register nahi karta, isliye woh vikalp bhi nir-aadhar hai. Exam point: Article 8 = videsh me rahne wale Indian origin vyakti ko bharat ke diplomatic ya consular representative ke paas registration ka adhikar.

qe: Article 11 of the Constitution gives Parliament the power to regulate citizenship, which Parliament exercised mainly by enacting which law?
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 11 संसद को नागरिकता नियमन की शक्ति देता है, जिसका प्रयोग संसद ने मुख्यतः कौन-सा कानून बनाकर किया?
oe: The Foreigners Act, 1946
The Citizenship Act, 1955
The Passports Act, 1967
The Representation of the People Act, 1950
oh: विदेशी अधिनियम, 1946
नागरिकता अधिनियम, 1955
पासपोर्ट अधिनियम, 1967
लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम, 1950
e: Article 11 Parliament ko shakti deta hai ki wo nagrikta ke arjan (paane) aur samapti (khone) ke baare me kanoon banaye; isi shakti ke tehat 1955 me Citizenship Act (nagrikta adhiniyam) banaya gaya. Yeh kanoon hi nagrikta ke paanch tareeke - janm, vansh, panjikaran, naturalisation aur kshetra-vistar - tay karta hai. Iske baad ke sanshodhan is pravah ko dikhate hain: 1986 ka sanshodhan janm ke aadhaar par nagrikta ki shart kadi karta hai, 2003 ka sanshodhan OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) ka pravdhan deta hai aur illegal migrant ki paribhasha tay karta hai, 2015 me PIO card ko OCI me mila diya jaata hai, aur 2019 ka sanshodhan kuch varg ke liye naturalisation ki avadhi ghata deta hai. Foreigners Act 1946 videshiyon ke prasvesh aur niyantran se juda hai, Passports Act 1967 yatra dastavez se, aur Representation of the People Act 1950 nirvachak suchi tatha parsiman se; inme kisi ko nagrikta dene ka pravdhan nahi hai. Exam point: nagrikta ka mukhya kanoon = Citizenship Act, 1955, jise 1986, 2003, 2015 aur 2019 me sanshodhit kiya gaya.

qe: Which of the following is NOT a mode of acquiring Indian citizenship under the Citizenship Act, 1955?
qh: नागरिकता अधिनियम, 1955 के अंतर्गत भारतीय नागरिकता प्राप्त करने का साधन निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा नहीं है?
oe: By birth
By descent
By naturalisation
By holding an Overseas Citizen of India card
oh: जन्म से
वंश के आधार पर
नागरिकीकरण (naturalisation) से
ओवरसीज सिटिजन ऑफ इंडिया कार्ड धारण करने से
e: Citizenship Act, 1955 nagrikta paane ke paanch raaste deta hai: janm (birth), vansh (descent), panjikaran (registration), naturalisation, aur bharat ke kshetra me samavisht kshetron ke nivasiyon ke liye asimilasyon (incorporation of territory). Janm, vansh aur naturalisation isi sauchi suchi ka hissa hain, isliye woh sahih tareeke hain. OCI card ek alag darja hai jo nagrikta nahi hai; ise 'dohri nagrikta' samajhna sabse aam galti hai. OCI cardholder bharat me bina visa lambi avadhi tak rah sakta hai aur shiksha tatha karyakshetra me bharatiya nagrikon jaisi suvidha paata hai, lekin uske paas vote dene ka adhikar nahi hota, woh rashtrapati, up-rashtrapati, sansad ya vidhanmandal ka sadasya, supreme court ya high court ka judge nahi ban sakta, aur krishi bhumi kharidne ka adhikar bhi uske paas nahi hota. Exam point: citizenship ke modes = janm, vansh, panjikaran, naturalisation aur kshetra-vistar; OCI card inme nahi aata kyunki woh nagrikta nahi hai.

qe: Which of the following is NOT a mode of losing Indian citizenship under the Citizenship Act, 1955?
qh: नागरिकता अधिनियम, 1955 के अंतर्गत भारतीय नागरिकता समाप्त होने का साधन निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा नहीं है?
oe: Renunciation of citizenship by the person himself
Termination on voluntarily acquiring the citizenship of another country
Deprivation of citizenship on grounds such as fraud or disloyalty to the Constitution
Deportation of the person from India
oh: व्यक्ति द्वारा स्वयं नागरिकता का परित्याग
किसी अन्य देश की नागरिकता स्वेच्छा से ग्रहण करने पर नागरिकता की समाप्ति
धोखाधड़ी या संविधान के प्रति निष्ठाहीनता जैसे आधारों पर नागरिकता का अपहरण (deprivation)
व्यक्ति का भारत से निर्वासन (deportation)
e: Citizenship Act, 1955 nagrikta khatam hone ke teen hi tareeke maanta hai. Pehla renunciation - vyakti khud likhit bayan dekar nagrikta chhodta hai. Doosra termination - jab vyakti swachchha se kisi doosre desh ki nagrikta le leta hai, to uski bharatiya nagrikta apne aap khatam ho jaati hai. Teesra deprivation - sarkar khaas aadhaaron par nagrikta chhinti hai, jaise dhokhadhadi se nagrikta lena, ya judd ke samay dushman desh ki sahayata karna, ya saaton saal se lagatar bharat ke baahar rahna. Deportation ka matlab hai kisi videshi vyakti ko desh se bahar bhej dena; yeh kadam bharat ke nagrik par lagta hi nahi, isliye woh nagrikta khone ka tareeka nahi ho sakta. Exam point: nagrikta khone ke teen raste = renunciation, termination aur deprivation; deportation videshiyon ke liye hai, nagrikta samapti ka mode nahi.

qe: Article 10 of the Constitution provides that every person who is or is deemed to be a citizen under the citizenship articles:
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 10 प्रावधान करता है कि नागरिकता से संबंधित अनुच्छेदों के अंतर्गत नागरिक होने वाला या माना जाने वाला प्रत्येक व्यक्ति -
oe: continues to be a citizen, subject to the provisions of any law made by Parliament
becomes a citizen only by naturalisation
is a citizen forever, irrespective of any law made by Parliament
must renew his citizenship every ten years
oh: नागरिक बना रहता है, किंतु संसद द्वारा बनाए गए किसी कानून के प्रावधानों के अधीन
केवल नागरिकीकरण द्वारा ही नागरिक बनता है
संसद के किसी कानून की परवाह किए बिना सदा के लिए नागरिक है
उसे प्रत्येक दस वर्ष में अपनी नागरिकता का नवीनीकरण कराना पड़ता है
e: Article 10 'continuance of the rights of citizenship' ka pravdhan karta hai: jo vyakti Article 5 se Article 9 ke tehat nagrik hai ya nagrik maana gaya hai, woh nagrik bana rehta hai, lekin uski yeh sthiti Parliament dwara banaye gaye kanoon ke adheen hai. Yehi clause Article 11 se juda hai, jahan Parliament ko nagrikta ke arjan aur samapti ke baare me kanoon banane ki shakti mili hai; isi shakti se Citizenship Act 1955 aaya. 'Hamesha ke liye' wala vikalp galat hai kyunki Article 10 khud kanoon ke adheen rehne ki baat karta hai. Naturalisation nagrikta paane ka ek tareeka hai, lekin Article 10 sirf naturalised logon par lagu nahi hota; woh sabhi nagrikon ke liye hai. Nagrikta ko das saal me renew karane jaisi koi vyavastha bharat me nahi hai, isliye woh vikalp bhi nir-aadhar hai. Exam point: Article 5 se 9 nagrikta dete hain, Article 10 uski nirantarta (continuance) batata hai, aur Article 11 Parliament ko kanoon banane ki shakti deta hai.

qe: In Article 1, the expression 'Union of States' was preferred over 'Federation of States' mainly because:
qh: अनुच्छेद 1 में 'राज्यों का संघ' (Union of States) शब्द का प्रयोग 'राज्यों का महासंघ' (Federation of States) की तुलना में मुख्यतः इसलिए किया गया क्योंकि -
oe: the Indian federation is the result of an agreement among the states, and the states have a right to secede
the Indian federation is not the result of an agreement among the states, and no state has the right to secede
the word federation is not used in any federal constitution of the world
the states in India enjoy equal powers in all matters, including residuary subjects
oh: भारतीय संघ राज्यों के आपसी समझौते का परिणाम है और राज्यों को अलग होने का अधिकार है
भारतीय संघ राज्यों के आपसी समझौते का परिणाम नहीं है और किसी राज्य को अलग होने का अधिकार नहीं है
दुनिया के किसी भी संघीय संविधान में federation शब्द का प्रयोग नहीं होता
भारत में राज्यों को अवशिष्ट (residuary) विषयों सहित सभी मामलों में समान शक्तियाँ प्राप्त हैं
e: Article 1(1) kehta hai - 'India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States'. Dr B.R. Ambedkar ne is chayan ka karan saaf kiya: bharatiya sangh kisi aapasi samjhauton se nahi bana, isliye usse 'Union' kaha gaya; aur kisi bhi rajya ko sambidhan se alag hone (secede karne) ka adhikar nahi hai. Isi wajah se 'rajyon ke aapas ke samjhauta ka parinaam' aur 'alag hone ka adhikar' - dono baatein asatya hain, kyunki sangh ka nirman sanvidhan se hua. Doosra vikalp galat saabit hota hai kyunki duniya ke kai sanghi sanvidhanon me federation shabd milta hai, jaise USA aur Australia; yah baat bharat ki khasiyat nahi hai. Teesra vikalp bhi galat hai kyunki avshisht (residuary) vishay Article 248 ke tehat Union ke paas hain, isliye rajy saman shakti ka dawa nahi kar sakte. Article 1(3) ke tehat 'territory of India' me rajya, sangh kshetra aur sanvidhan dwara arjit kshetra (acquired territories) shaamil hain. Exam point: Union of States = sangh samjhauta nahi, sanvidhan se bana, aur rajyon ko secede karne ka adhikar nahi.

qe: For introducing a bill in Parliament under Article 3 for forming a new state or altering the boundaries or name of a state, which of the following is required?
qh: अनुच्छेद 3 के अंतर्गत नया राज्य बनाने या किसी राज्य की सीमा/नाम बदलने का विधेयक संसद में लाने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से क्या आवश्यक है?
oe: The consent of the legislature of the affected state
The prior recommendation of the President and the opinion of the affected state legislature, which is not binding
The approval of the Supreme Court of India
A referendum in the affected state before introduction of the bill
oh: संबंधित राज्य की विधायिका की सहमति
राष्ट्रपति की पूर्व सिफारिश तथा संबंधित राज्य की विधायिका का मत, जो बाध्यकारी नहीं है
भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की स्वीकृति
विधेयक पेश करने से पहले संबंधित राज्य में जनमत संग्रह
e: Article 3 ke tehat naya rajya banane, seema badalne ya rajya ka naam badalne wala vidhayak sansad me laane se pehle Rashtrapati ki purva-sifarish (prior recommendation) lena anivarya hai. Uske baad vidhayak ko sansad ke nirdesh par rajya ki vidhayika ke paas bheja jaata hai taaki woh apna mat 15 din ke andar vyakt kar sake; lekin yeh mat sirf salah hota hai, Rashtrapati ya sansad us par bandha hua nahi hota. Isliye rajya vidhayika ki 'sahamati' (consent) maangna galat hai - sanvidhan me sirf 'opinion' maanga gaya hai, woh bhi manya nahi. Supreme Court ki manzoori ya janmat sangrah (referendum) ka koi zikr Article 3 me nahi hai; isi wajah se 1956, 1960, 2000 aur 2014 ke punargathan sansad ke sadharan bahumat se bhi sambhav ho paaye. Exam point: Article 3 = Rashtrapati ki purva-sifarish plus rajya vidhayika ka mat (non-binding); rajya ki sahmati ki zaroorat nahi.

qe: Laws made by Parliament under Articles 2 and 3 are:
qh: संसद द्वारा अनुच्छेद 2 और अनुच्छेद 3 के अंतर्गत बनाए गए कानून -
oe: deemed to be an amendment of the Constitution under Article 368
not deemed to be an amendment of the Constitution, although they alter the First and Fourth Schedules
invalid unless ratified by the legislatures of half of the states
required to be approved by a referendum of the affected people
oh: अनुच्छेद 368 के अर्थ में संविधान का संशोधन माने जाएँगे
संविधान का संशोधन नहीं माने जाएँगे, यद्यपि वे प्रथम तथा चतुर्थ अनुसूची में परिवर्तन करते हैं
अर्ध से अधिक राज्यों की विधायिकाओं के अनुमोदन के बिना अवैध होंगे
संबंधित जनता के जनमत संग्रह से स्वीकृत होना आवश्यक होगा
e: Article 4 ka saaf pravdhan hai ki Article 2 aur Article 3 ke tehat banaya gaya kanoon Article 368 ke matlab me sanvidhan sanshodhan nahi maana jayega, chaahe woh rajy ki suchi (First Schedule) tatha Rajya Sabha me rajyon ke pratinidhitva wali suchi (Fourth Schedule) ko badal de. Isi apvad ki wajah se naya rajya banane ke liye sansad ko sirf sadharan bahumat chahiye hota hai; Article 368 wali vishesh bahumat, adhe rajyon ka anumodan (ratification) aur janmat sangrah jaisi prakriyayein is pravdhan par lagu nahi hain. Isliye 'Article 368 ka sanshodhan' wala vikalp galat hai, 'adhe rajyon ka anumodan' wala vikalp bhi galat hai kyunki yeh shart sirf kuch sanshodhanon par lagti hai, aur janmat sangrah ka koi zikr sanvidhan me nahi hai. Exam point: Article 4 = Article 2 tatha 3 ke kanoon sanshodhan nahi maane jaate, isliye naya rajya ya naam-parivartan sadharan bahumat se hi ho jaata hai.

qe: As listed in the First Schedule of the Constitution today, India consists of how many states and Union Territories?
qh: संविधान की प्रथम अनुसूची में आज भारत में कितने राज्य तथा केंद्र शासित प्रदेश सूचीबद्ध हैं?
oe: 25 states and 9 Union Territories
28 states and 8 Union Territories
29 states and 7 Union Territories
28 states and 7 Union Territories
oh: 25 राज्य तथा 9 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश
28 राज्य तथा 8 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश
29 राज्य तथा 7 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश
28 राज्य तथा 7 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश
e: First Schedule me rajyon aur sangh kshetron (Union Territories) ki suchi di gayi hai, aur Article 1(3) ke tehat 'territory of India' me rajya, sangh kshetra tatha arjit kshetra shaamil hote hain. 2019 me Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act ke tehat purane rajya Jammu-Kashmir ko do sangh kshetron me baanta gaya - Jammu and Kashmir (jiske paas vidhanmandal hai) aur Ladakh (jiske paas vidhanmandal nahi hai). Iske baad bharat me 28 rajya aur 8 kirya kshetra reh gaye. 29 rajya aur 7 sangh kshetra wala aakda purani sthiti ka hai, jab Jammu-Kashmir ek rajya tha; 25 and 9 bhi kisi known sthiti se mel nahi khaata; aur 28 rajya ke saath 7 sangh kshetra galat hai kyunki sangh kshetron ki sankhya 8 hai. Exam point: First Schedule = rajya aur sangh kshetron ki suchi; aaj 28 rajya aur 8 sangh kshetra, kyunki 2019 me J&K do sangh kshetron me banta.

qe: The States Reorganisation Act of 1956, based on the recommendations of the States Reorganisation Commission headed by Fazl Ali, created:
qh: फजल अली की अध्यक्षता वाले राज्य पुनर्गठन आयोग की सिफारिशों पर आधारित राज्य पुनर्गठन अधिनियम, 1956 ने क्या बनाया?
oe: 14 states and 6 Union Territories
16 states and 9 Union Territories
27 states and 9 Union Territories
12 states and 5 Union Territories
oh: 14 राज्य तथा 6 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश
16 राज्य तथा 9 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश
27 राज्य तथा 9 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश
12 राज्य तथा 5 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश
e: 1953 me Kartar Singh ki adhyakshata wali samiti ke baad Fazl Ali ki adhyakshata me States Reorganisation Commission bani, jisne rajyon ke punargathan ko bhasha ke aadhaar par sujhav diya. 1956 ka States Reorganisation Act us sifarish par lagu hua aur 14 rajya tatha 6 sangh kshetra bane; isi ke saath purane teen vargon - Part A, Part B aur Part C states - ki vyavastha khatam ho gayi. Iske baad bhasha ke aadhaar par aur rajya bante rahe: 1960 me Gujarat aur Maharashtra, 1966 me Punjab aur Haryana, 2000 me Chhattisgarh, Uttarakhand aur Jharkhand (teen naye rajya), aur 2014 me Telangana. Isliye 16 rajya aur 9 sangh kshetra, 27 rajya aur 9 sangh kshetra, ya 12 rajya aur 5 sangh kshetra jaise aakde kisi bhi known punargathan se match nahi karte. Exam point: 1956 = 14 rajya plus 6 sangh kshetra (Fazl Ali Commission); 2000 = 3 naye rajya; 2014 = Telangana.

qe: Which Union Territory has a special constitutional provision (Article 239AA) creating a Legislative Assembly with power over State List subjects except public order, police and land?
qh: किस केंद्र शासित प्रदेश के लिए विशेष संवैधानिक प्रावधान (अनुच्छेद 239AA) है, जिसके अंतर्गत विधान सभा बनती है जिसके पास लोक व्यवस्था, पुलिस तथा भूमि को छोड़कर राज्य सूची के विषयों पर शक्ति होती है?
oe: Puducherry
National Capital Territory of Delhi
Jammu & Kashmir
Ladakh
oh: पुदुचेरी
राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र दिल्ली
जम्मू और कश्मीर
लद्दाख
e: 69th Constitutional Amendment (1991) ne Delhi ko 'National Capital Territory' banaya aur Article 239AA joda. Iske tehat `National Capital Territory of Delhi` me vidhan sabha banti hai aur wo State List ke vishyon par vidheyak bana sakti hai, lekin lok vyavastha (public order), police aur bhumi (land) in teen vishyon ko iske dayre se baahar rakha gaya hai. Isi karan Delhi sarkar aur kendra ke beech adhikar ka batwara baar-baar vivaad ka vishay ban jaata hai. Puducherry ke paas bhi vidhan sabha hai, lekin uska adhaar Government of Union Territories Act, 1963 aur Article 239A hai, Article 239AA nahi; isliye Puducherry wala vikalp galat hai. Jammu and Kashmir ko 2019 ke punargathan ke baad vidhan sabha mili hai, par woh bhi 239A wali vyavastha hai, aur Ladakh ke paas kahin vidhan sabha nahi hai. Exam point: Article 239AA = Delhi NCT (69th Amendment 1991, teen vishay chhodkar); Article 239A = vidhanmandal wale anya sangh kshetra jaise Puducherry aur J&K.

qe: Under Article 343, the official language of the Union is Hindi in Devanagari script; the continued use of English for official purposes of the Union is governed by:
qh: अनुच्छेद 343 के अंतर्गत संघ की राजभाषा देवनागरी लिपि में हिंदी है; संघ के राजकीय कार्यों में अंग्रेजी के निरंतर प्रयोग का आधार क्या है?
oe: The Official Languages Act, 1963
The English Language (Continuance) Order, 1947
Article 351 itself
The Committee of Parliament on Official Language, 1976
oh: राजभाषा अधिनियम, 1963
अंग्रेजी भाषा (निरंतरता) आदेश, 1947
स्वयं अनुच्छेद 351
राजभाषा पर संसदीय समिति, 1976
e: Article 343 ke anusaar sangh ki rajbhasha Hindi (Devanagari lipi) hai aur ankdon ke antarrashtriya roop (international form of Indian numerals) ka prayog hoga; isme yeh bhi likha tha ki 1965 ke baad angreji ka istemal band ho jaayega. Lekin non-Hindi bhasha bhashi rajyon ke virodh tatha hinsa ki ghatnaon ke baad 1963 me Official Languages Act (Rajbhasha Adhiniyam) aaya, jiski Section 3 ke tehat angreji sangh ke rajkiya karam ke liye Hindi ke saath-saath 'jaari rah sakti hai' - aur vyavhar me usse anishchit kal tak jaari rakha gaya hai. 'English Language (Continuance) Order, 1947' naam ki koi vyavastha nahi hai; Article 351 sirf Hindi ke vikas ka nirdesh deta hai, angreji ke prayog ka nahi; aur Committee of Parliament on Official Language (1976) samiksha karti hai, kanoon nahi deti. Exam point: rajbhasha = Article 343 plus Official Languages Act, 1963; 1965 ke baad angreji ka istemal isi adhiniyam ke tehat jaari raha.

qe: How many languages are in the Eighth Schedule today, and by which amendment were Maithili, Bodo, Dogri and Santhali added?
qh: आज आठवीं अनुसूची में कितनी भाषाएँ हैं, और मैथिली, बोडो, डोगरी तथा संताली किस संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ी गईं?
oe: 18; 71st Amendment
22; 92nd Amendment
22; 71st Amendment
24; 92nd Amendment
e: Sanvidhan ki Eighth Schedule me shuru me 14 bhashayein thi. Sindhi ko 21st Amendment (1967) se joda gaya, kyunki vibhajan ke baad woh bharat me aayi; Konkani, Manipuri aur Nepali 71st Amendment (1992) se jodi gayi; aur Bodo, Dogri, Maithili tatha Santhali 92nd Amendment (2003) se jodi gayi, jisse kul sankhya 22 ho gayi. Isliye Maithili - jo Bihar ki ek pramukh bhasha hai aur ab Eighth Schedule me hai - 2003 me shaamil hui; ise 1992 ya kisi anya saal se jodna galat hai. Eighth Schedule bhashaon ka koi bhasha-wise official-language ka darja nahi deta; woh bhashayein hain jinhein Sanskrit aur Hindi ke saath samriddh karne ka nirdesh Article 351 me hai, aur unke vikas ke liye sanvidhan me alag pravdhan hain. Exam point: 14 se 22 - Sindhi 1967 (21st), Konkani/Manipuri/Nepali 1992 (71st), Bodo/Dogri/Maithili/Santhali 2003 (92nd).

qe: Which body was set up under Section 4 of the Official Languages Act, 1963 to review the progress in the use of Hindi for official purposes and make recommendations?
qh: राजकीय कार्यों में हिंदी के प्रयोग की प्रगति की समीक्षा कर सिफारिशें देने के लिए राजभाषा अधिनियम, 1963 की धारा 4 के अंतर्गत कौन-सी संस्था गठित की गई?
oe: Official Language Commission under Article 344
Committee of Parliament on Official Language
Department of Official Language
Hindi Advisory Committee of the Law Ministry
oh: अनुच्छेद 344 के अंतर्गत राजभाषा आयोग
राजभाषा पर संसदीय समिति
राजभाषा विभाग
विधि मंत्रालय की हिंदी सलाहकार समिति
e: Article 344 ke tehat Rashtrapati dwara ek Official Language Commission niyukt ki jaati hai, jisme ek adhyaksh tatha sangh tatha rajyon ke pratinidhi hote hain; pehli aisi aayog 1955 me bani thi jiske adhyaksh Bal Gangadhar Kher the. Iske alag, Official Languages Act, 1963 ki Section 4 ke tehat sansad ki ek samiti ka gathan hota hai - Committee of Parliament on Official Language; iska gathan 1976 me hua aur isme lok sabha ke 20 tatha rajya sabha ke 10 sadasya hote hain. Yeh samiti Hindi ke prayog ki samiksha karti hai aur Rashtrapati ke madhyam se sansad ko sifarish karti hai. Department of Official Language (Rajbhasha Vibhag) ek prashasanik vibhag hai, sanvaidhanik ya adhiniyam-presit samiti nahi, isliye woh vikalp galat hai; Law Ministry ki aisi koi committee sanvidhan ya adhiniyam me nahi hai. Exam point: Article 344 = Official Language Commission; Section 4 of the 1963 Act = Committee of Parliament on Official Language (1976).

qe: Under Article 348, the proceedings of the Supreme Court and High Courts are in English; the Governor of a state may authorise the use of Hindi in High Court proceedings:
qh: अनुच्छेद 348 के अंतर्गत सर्वोच्च न्यायालय तथा उच्च न्यायालयों की कार्यवाही अंग्रेजी में होती है; राज्यपाल उच्च न्यायालय की कार्यवाही में हिंदी के प्रयोग की अनुमति -
oe: with the consent of the Chief Justice of India
with the previous consent of the President
on a resolution of the state legislature
on the recommendation of the Supreme Court collegium
oh: भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश की सहमति से
राष्ट्रपति की पूर्व सहमति से
राज्य विधायिका के प्रस्ताव पर
सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के कॉलेजियम की सिफारिश पर
e: Article 348(1) ka niyam hai ki Supreme Court aur sabhi High Courts ki karyavahi tatha unke judgment, decree aur order angreji me honge, jab tak sansad kanoon bana kar anyatha nirdharit na kare. Article 348(2) ek apvad deta hai: kisi rajy ka Rajyapal, Rashtrapati ki purva-sehmati (previous consent) lekar us rajya ke High Court ki karyavahi me Hindi ya us rajya ki rajbhasha ka prayog karane ki anumati de sakta hai, lekin nirnay, decree tatha order angreji me hi rahenge. Isliye CJI ki sahmati, rajya vidhayika ka prastav ya collegium ki sifarish ka koi zikr nahi hai - in teeno vikalpon ka sanvidhan me koi adhaar nahi hai. Dhyaan rahe ki aisi anumati ke baad bhi High Court ke faisle angreji me hi likhe jaate hain, sirf bahas aur karyavahi ki bhasha badalti hai. Exam point: Article 348(1) = nyayalay ki bhasha angreji; Article 348(2) = Rashtrapati ki purva-sehmati se Hindi/rajbhasha ki anumati, par judgment angreji me hi.

qe: Article 351 directs the Union to promote the spread of Hindi and develop it as a medium of expression of India's composite culture; it specifically asks for this to be done by:
qh: अनुच्छेद 351 संघ को हिंदी के प्रसार तथा उसे भारत की समग्र संस्कृति की अभिव्यक्ति का माध्यम बनाने का निर्देश देता है; इसमें विशेष रूप से कहा गया है कि यह कार्य किया जाए -
oe: by replacing all regional languages in government work at once
by securing its enrichment through assimilation, without interfering with its genius, of the forms and expressions of Hindustani and other languages of India specified in the Eighth Schedule
by making Hindi the only language of the courts immediately
by banning the use of English in Parliament proceedings
oh: सरकारी कामकाज में सभी क्षेत्रीय भाषाओं को तत्काल हटाकर
हिंदुस्तानी तथा आठवीं अनुसूची में उल्लिखित भारत की अन्य भाषाओं के रूपों और अभिव्यक्तियों को, उसकी प्रकृति में हस्तक्षेप किए बिना, आत्मसात करके उसका संवर्धन सुनिश्चित करके
हिंदी को तत्काल न्यायालयों की एकमात्र भाषा बनाकर
संसद की कार्यवाही में अंग्रेजी के प्रयोग पर प्रतिबंध लगाकर
e: Article 351 kehta hai ki sangh ka kartavya hoga Hindi ka prasar badhana, usse samruddh karna taaki woh bharat ki sammil rachna... 'composite culture' ke sabhi tatvon ki abhivyakti ka madhyam ban sake, aur iske liye Hindi ke roop grahan karna chahiye - bina uski prakriti (genius) me hastakshep kiye - Hindustani tatha Eighth Schedule me di gayi bharat ki anya bhashaon ke shabd aur abhivyaktiyan. Yahi clause dikhata hai ki sanvidhan Hindi ko thosna nahi chahta, balki doosri bhashaon se samriddh karna chahta hai. Isliye regional bhashaon ko turant hatane, nyayalayon ki bhasha turant badalne ya English par rok lagane wale vikalp Article 351 ke virodh me hain aur sanvidhan me kahin aise nirdesh nahi milte. Prathmik star par maatrabhasha me shiksha ka nirdesh alag se Article 350A me diya gaya hai. Exam point: Article 351 = Hindi ka vikas Hindustani aur Eighth Schedule ki bhashaon ke shabdon ko apna kar, unhe hatakar nahi.

qe: Which of the following pairs about the language provisions of the Constitution is correctly matched?
qh: संविधान के भाषा संबंधी प्रावधानों से संबंधित निम्नलिखित युग्मों में कौन-सा सही सुमेलित है?
oe: Article 350A - Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities
Article 350B - instruction in the mother tongue at the primary stage
Article 350A - instruction in the mother tongue at the primary stage, and Article 350B - Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities
Article 350 - creation of the Committee of Parliament on Official Language
oh: अनुच्छेद 350A - भाषाई अल्पसंख्यकों के लिए विशेष अधिकारी
अनुच्छेद 350B - प्राथमिक स्तर पर मातृभाषा में शिक्षा
अनुच्छेद 350A - प्राथमिक स्तर पर मातृभाषा में शिक्षा, तथा अनुच्छेद 350B - भाषाई अल्पसंख्यकों के लिए विशेष अधिकारी
अनुच्छेद 350 - राजभाषा पर संसदीय समिति का गठन
e: 7th Constitutional Amendment (1956) ne bhasha ke kshetra me do naye pravdhan jode. Article 350A kehta hai ki rajya tatha sthaneya pradhikari prathmik star par shiksha ke madhyam ke roop me bachchon ki matrabhasha ka upyog karne ka prayas karengi; yeh bhashai alpsankhyakon ke hit me nirdesh hai. Article 350B ke tehat Rashtrapati ek vishesh padadhikari (Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities) niyukt karte hain, jinka karyalay Allahabad me hai aur jo vaidhanik bahumat ke mudde sanvidhan dwara tay raah par le jaate hain, taaki rajyon ko salah di ja sake. Isliye 350A aur 350B ki jodi ulti karne wale vikalp galat hain aur keval ek ko sahi batane wale vikalp bhi adhoore hain. Article 350 alag vishay hai - woh kisi bhi vyakti ko sangh ya rajya ke karyalayon me apni shikayat kisi bhi bhasha me dene ka adhikar deta hai; uska Committee of Parliament with Official Language se koi sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: 350 = shikayat ki bhasha, 350A = matrabhasha me prathmik shiksha, 350B = bhashai alpsankhyak aayukta.

qe: In Bihar, which language other than Hindi enjoys the status of an additional/second official language of the state?
qh: बिहार में हिंदी के अतिरिक्त किस भाषा को राज्य की अतिरिक्त/द्वितीय राजभाषा का दर्जा प्राप्त है?
oe: Maithili
Urdu
Bhojpuri
Angika
oh: मैथिली
उर्दू
भोजपुरी
अंगिका
e: Article 345 rajya vidhayika ko shakti deta hai ki woh rajya ki rajbhasha tatha uske saath Hindi ke alava ek ya adhik bhashaon ko apna sake; Bihar ne isi shakti ka upyog karke Hindi ko rajbhasha banaya aur Urdu ko dwitiya rajbhasha (second official language) ka darja diya. Bihar ki bhasha-niti me Urdu ka sashan, shiksha tatha karyalayi kaam me prayog hota hai, isliye is prashn ka sahi jawab Urdu hai. Maithili bharat ki ek pramukh bhasha hai aur 2003 (92nd Amendment) se Eighth Schedule me shaamil hai, lekin Bihar ki dwitiya rajbhasha Urdu hi hai, Maithili nahi. Bhojpuri aur Angika Bihar ki kai bhashayein hain jinhein lok-priyata prapt hai, par unhe rajbhasha ka darja nahi mila hai; isliye yeh dono vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Article 345 = rajya ki rajbhasha chunne ki shakti; Bihar = Hindi rajbhasha tatha Urdu dwitiya rajbhasha; Maithili = Eighth Schedule bhasha (2003).
